cards.title: What's going on with Fabry disease
cards.text: Fabry disease is caused by changes in a gene called GLA, which is like an instruction book for making a helper protein called an enzyme [E732dff2, Ebeec4d7]. Because of these gene changes, the body does not make enough of this enzyme, called alpha-galactosidase A, or the enzyme does not work the way it should [Ed4574b4, E7f9dfd8, E3d58547, Ef0870fb, E993c5a9]. This enzyme is supposed to work inside lysosomes, which are tiny parts of cells that normally help break down fatty substances [E4b5796e, E7328024, Eb305e87, E81c4573, E58d2a7e, E3b56952, E66d6b66, E7dab347, E1577d5e]. When the enzyme does not work well, a fatty substance called globotriaosylceramide slowly builds up in cells all over the body [Ee0e2214, E5b662da, E2cdb1f6, E4442b91, E5f25d91, E487816a, E871c351, Ef74cc75]. A paper reports that this build-up can affect the heart, for example by thickening the heart muscle [Eeba9fed, E3405095, E9408782, E0368ba1, E4995585, E8d605c3]. A paper also reports that problems with the tiny energy-making parts of cells, called mitochondria, may also play a part in Fabry disease [E857b746, E4d8de14].

cards.title: Diseases that share the same biology
cards.text: Gaucher disease is biologically similar to Fabry: it also comes from a missing lysosome enzyme and the same kind of fatty build-up, and both diseases use the same body pathway for breaking down these fats [Ec8d1187, E309fa8a, Ed85e96b, E8a2d502]. Krabbe disease follows the same pattern, with its own missing enzyme causing a similar fatty build-up through that same pathway [E3f6bbf0, E60744b8, E6e63617, E6be1459]. Parkinson disease that starts later in life can also involve a missing lysosome enzyme and fatty build-up tied to the same pathway, in people who carry changes in a related gene [E8b12886, Ece278e5, Ea15cf24]. GM2 AB variant and MLD (metachromatic leukodystrophy) are connected to Fabry through this same fat-processing pathway as well, each with their own missing enzyme causing a similar kind of build-up [Edcf2ca7, Ee27a382, E7470be0, Eb39398b].

cards.title: What already exists
cards.text: Patient groups around the world focus on Fabry disease, including the MPS Society in the United Kingdom, the Canadian Fabry Association, the Fabry Support & Information Group in the United States, and ABRAFF in Brazil [Ea5b7539, E6e80d7b, Edcdc139, E9abab66]. A study called 'Safety, PK/PD, and Exploratory Efficacy Study of AMT-191 in Classic Fabry Disease' is recruiting participants in the United States [Ec26ea35, E51e1c00, Ebaf84c8]. Another study is recruiting in the United States to look at the medicines migalastat HCl and ERT for people with Fabry disease [Ea2c0813, Ee204e48, E68f4368, E5fa73db]. A fitness improvement training study for Fabry disease is recruiting in Czechia [E68b5013, Ef495801]. A research grant called 'Mechanisms of Neuronal Excitability and Pain in Fabry Disease' is funded by NIH NINDS to study Fabry disease [E7a2b934, Ef4fa32d].

cards.title: Possible next steps
cards.text: A good first step could be reaching out to the MPS Society, a patient group based in the United Kingdom that the atlas links to Fabry disease, for support and information [Ea5b7539, E6bc9b9e, E6aaa2df]. You could also reach out to the Fabry Support & Information Group, a patient group based in the United States that the atlas links to Fabry disease [Edcdc139, E245eca1]. After connecting with these groups, it may be worth asking whether the Krabbe Disease Global Patient Registry, which already exists for Krabbe disease, could be expanded or copied to include Fabry disease as well, since Fabry does not yet have one of its own [E92ff8aa].
